facts.fact: We Are Tech says that on 23 October 2025 the 'Digital Algeria 2030' strategy had been finalised and was expected to begin implementation soon, naming no adopting act.

The High Commission for Digitalisation, set up in 2023 to spearhead digital transformation, launched its 15-member Scientific and Technical Committee on 23 October 2025 to advise on national digital policy and review draft digitalisation legislation.
The article gives the strategy's targets: training 500,000 ICT specialists, connecting all public institutions and raising the digital economy's share of GDP to 20% by 2030; no cost is stated.
The High Commission for Digitalisation installed its Scientific and Technical Committee on 23 October 2025, completing its institutional set-up.
